concept: Finding something to appreciate even on a hard or disappointing day
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Anne Frank's legacy of finding light in hardship — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character has a genuinely disappointing day but still finds one small thing to appreciate
exercise.reflection_prompt: Did finding something good erase the hard part of the day, or just sit alongside it?
exercise.practice: Student names one hard day and one small good thing that was still true on it

assessment.success_marker: student holds both the hard part and the good part without dismissing either
